translation: About 200,000 soldiers from twenty-two divisions of thirteen army corps were transferred into the Beijing region under the state of siege, after the People’s Armed Police proved unable to contain the demonstrations.

translation: The 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and massacre, called by the Chinese government the 4 June incident, consisted of a series of demonstrations led by Chinese students between 15 April and 4 June 1989, plus their later repression ordered by the authorities of the People’s Republic of China.

quote: Elles se concluent par une vague de répression, parfois englobée sous l'expression de massacre de la place Tian'anmen.
translation: They ended in a wave of repression, sometimes covered by the expression massacre of Tiananmen Square.

translation: Tiananmen massacre is the widespread name for the violent suppression of a protest movement in which Tiananmen Square in Beijing was occupied by an originally student democracy movement.

quote: Разгон известен как «события 4 июня» (кит. 六四事件) в Китае и «бойня на площади Тяньаньмэнь» (англ. Tiananmen Square Massacre) на Западе.
translation: The dispersal is known as the “events of 4 June” in China and as the “Tiananmen Square Massacre” in the West.

translation: Through that day’s editorial, the People’s Daily defined the protests by demonstrators, workers, and migrant workers as a ‘counter-revolutionary riot.’

translation: In the early hours of 4 June 1989, the People’s Liberation Army moved through Beijing’s streets with soldiers and tanks and began suppressing the demonstrators.

quote: 六四事件，又稱八九民运、八九学运或六四天安門事件，中国大陆官方称1989年春夏之交的政治风波或反革命暴乱，广义上是指自1989年4月中旬开始的，以胡耀邦逝世为导火索、由中国大陆高校学生发起、持续近两个月，要求反腐败、新闻自由及政治改革的全国性示威活動；狭义上指六四清场，即同年6月3日晚间至6月4日凌晨，中央军委调集解放军戒严部队、武警部队与民警在天安门广场及周边地区进行的武力清场行动。
translation: The June Fourth incident, also called the 1989 democracy or student movement or the June Fourth Tiananmen incident, is officially called in mainland China the political turmoil of the late spring and early summer of 1989 or a counter-revolutionary riot; broadly it was a nationwide demonstration from mid-April demanding anti-corruption, press freedom, and political reform, and narrowly it was the armed clearance of the square and surrounding area from the evening of 3 June to the early hours of 4 June.

translation: Estimates of the deaths vary between 200 and 2,000 according to people who were present, although they occurred outside the square.

translation: The repression of the movement caused several hundred, or even several thousand, deaths, and many arrests in the following months.

quote: 그 후 중화인민공화국 공안부가 1990년 7월 10일 제5차 국무원 보고에서 정식 발표한 것을 따르면, 민간인 사망자는 875명, 민간인 부상자는 약 14,550명이었으며, 군인과 전경은 56명이 사망, 7,528명이 부상당했다.
translation: Afterward, according to what the PRC Ministry of Public Security officially announced in the 5th State Council report on 10 July 1990, civilian deaths were 875, civilian injured were about 14,550, and soldiers and riot police had 56 deaths and 7,528 injured.

quote: 1990年7月10日，中华人民共和国公安部向国务院提交的内部文件《有关各地动乱、暴乱中伤亡情况统计资料汇总》中统计，1989年整个事件期间全国共有931人死亡，2.2万余人受伤。其中北京有群众523人（北京学生57人，北京居民45人，外地学生171人，外地职工、居民和农民229人，另有身份不详者21人）、军警45人死亡，另有11570人受伤。
translation: On 10 July 1990, an internal document submitted by the PRC Ministry of Public Security to the State Council, 'Summary of Statistical Data on Casualties in Turmoil and Riots Across Various Regions', counted that during the entire 1989 incident nationwide there were 931 deaths and over 22,000 injured. Among them, in Beijing 523 civilians (57 Beijing students, 45 Beijing residents, 171 out-of-town students, 229 out-of-town workers, residents and peasants, and 21 unidentified) and 45 military/police died, with another 11,570 injured.

quote: 鄧小平中軍委主席の決定により5月19日に北京市に戒厳令が布告され、武力介入の可能性が高まったため、趙紫陽総書記や知識人たちは学生たちに対してデモの平和的解散を促したが、学生たちの投票では強硬派が多数を占め、デモ継続を強行したため首都機能は麻痺に陥った。
translation: By the decision of CMC Chairman Deng Xiaoping, martial law was proclaimed in Beijing on May 19, and because the possibility of armed intervention increased, General Secretary Zhao Ziyang and intellectuals urged the students to peacefully dissolve the demonstrations, but hardliners held the majority in the students' vote and forced the continuation of the demonstrations, paralyzing the capital's functions.

quote: Sau khi một số người biểu tình quá khích tấn công, giết hại một số binh lính và đốt các đoàn xe vào ngày 20 tháng 5, Quốc vụ viện tuyên bố thiết quân luật và quân đội đã tiến vào trung tâm Bắc Kinh vào sáng sớm ngày 4 tháng 6, các vụ đụng độ đã gây thương vong cho cả người biểu tình và binh sĩ.
translation: After some extremist protesters attacked, killed several soldiers and burned convoys on May 20, the State Council declared martial law and the military advanced into central Beijing in the early morning of June 4, clashes caused casualties for both protesters and soldiers.

quote: Chính phủ Trung Quốc ban đầu chỉ đàm phán để người biểu tình tự giải tán, nhưng sau khi một số người biểu tình quá khích tấn công, giết hại một số binh lính và đốt các đoàn xe, ngày 4 tháng 6, chính phủ tuyên bố thiết quân luật và cử quân đội dẹp bỏ những người biểu tình đang đóng tại Quảng trường Thiên An Môn. Trái với ấn tượng do truyền thông phuơng Tây tạo ra, thực tế quân Trung Quốc chủ yếu dùng dùi cui và gậy gộc chứ không nổ súng.
translation: The Chinese government initially only negotiated for the protesters to disperse themselves, but after some extremist protesters attacked, killed several soldiers and burned convoys, on June 4, the government declared martial law and sent the military to clear the protesters camped in Tiananmen Square. Contrary to the impression created by Western media, in reality the Chinese military mainly used batons and sticks rather than firing guns.

quote: On 20 May, the State Council declared martial law, and as many as 300,000 troops were mobilized to Beijing, but were halted by mass nonviolent resistance from the protestors and Beijing's civilian population.

Meses antes de la represión, la Agencia Central de Inteligencia (CIA) ayudó activamente a los activistas estudiantiles a formar el movimiento, proporcionándoles diverso equipamiento, como máquinas de escribir y máquinas de fax.
translation: Months before the crackdown, the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) actively helped student activists form the movement, providing them with various equipment, such as typewriters and fax machines.

quote: また、デモへの支援は外国の西側諸国からも行われ、米中央情報局（CIA）は、学生活動家たちの間に情報提供者のネットワークを構築し、反政府運動の形成に積極的な協力を見せ、タイプライターやファックスなどさまざまな機材を提供したとされる。のちに、CIAは英MI6とともに何人かの反体制派指導者の密出国に関与することになる。
translation: Support for the demonstrations also came from foreign Western countries, and the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) is said to have built a network of informants among student activists, actively cooperated in forming the anti-government movement, and provided various equipment such as typewriters and fax machines. Later, the CIA along with the British MI6 became involved in smuggling out several dissident leaders.

quote: Bộ Ngoại giao Pháp cũng như các cơ quan tình báo phương Tây như Cơ quan tình báo mật của Anh (MI6) và Cơ quan tình báo trung ương Hoa Kỳ (CIA) và Tổng cục an ninh đối ngoại pháp (DGSE) đã tham gia vào chiến dịch này, bao gồm việc bí mật đưa vào Trung Quốc các loại vũ khí, kính nhìn đêm và các thiết bị gây nhiễu sóng
section: Chiến dịch Chim hoàng yến của tình báo phương Tây
translation: The French Ministry of Foreign Affairs as well as Western intelligence agencies such as the British Secret Intelligence Service (MI6) and the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and the French Directorate-General for External Security (DGSE) participated in this operation, including secretly smuggling weapons, night vision goggles, and jamming equipment into China.

quote: Tình báo của phương Tây đã phát động Chiến dịch Chim hoàng yến, giúp các nhân vật lãnh đạo cuộc biểu tình trốn ra nước ngoài qua ngả Hồng Kông nhằm đưa họ trở thành các lãnh đạo phong trào chống Nhà nước Trung Quốc trong tương lai Chiến dịch này về sau được tiết lộ, càng làm củng cố quan điểm của chính phủ Trung Quốc rằng phong trào biểu tình này là kết quả của sự giật dây từ các thế lực phương Tây nhằm gây chia rẽ và nội chiến hòng lật đổ nhà nước Trung Quốc, một chiến lược đã được phương Tây lặp lại trong các phong trào Cách mạng màu, Mùa xuân Ả Rập tại Đông Âu, Trung Đông vào thập niên 2000.
translation: Western intelligence launched Operation Yellowbird, helping protest leaders flee abroad via Hong Kong in order to make them leaders of future anti-Chinese State movements. This operation was later revealed, further reinforcing the Chinese government's view that this protest movement was the result of string-pulling by Western forces to cause division and civil war in order to overthrow the Chinese state, a strategy repeated by the West in the Color Revolutions and Arab Spring movements in Eastern Europe and the Middle East in the 2000s.

quote: Some student leaders, such as Chai Ling and Wuer Kaixi, were able to escape to the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and other Western nations under Operation Yellowbird, which was organised by Western intelligence agencies such as MI6 and CIA from Hong Kong, a British territory at the time.
C'est un homme seul, vêtu d'une chemise blanche, debout devant une colonne de chars qui tente de quitter la place.
translation: It is a lone man, dressed in a white shirt, standing in front of a column of tanks trying to leave the square.

quote: 戦車男を目撃したNHK記者の加藤青延は「服装が政府側の人物のように見え、戦車が人を轢かないことをアピールするための自作自演の中国政府の行動であろう」としている。加藤の取材によればこれは6月5日に隣接する長安街の外国取材陣の前でおきた出来事である。男性は身元不明だがデモ隊ではなく中国政府側の人間だと思われる。中国政府の自作自演で「戦車は民衆を轢かないよ」というパフォーマンスとして行われたものである。
translation: NHK reporter Harunobu Kato, who witnessed Tank Man, states that 'his clothing looked like that of someone on the government side, and it was probably a self-staged act by the Chinese government to appeal that tanks do not run over people.' According to Kato's reporting, this happened on June 5 in front of the foreign press corps on adjacent Chang'an Avenue. Although the man's identity is unknown, he is thought to be someone on the Chinese government side rather than a protester. It was carried out as a performance staged by the Chinese government to show 'tanks do not run over the people.'

quote: A column of tanks of the 1st Armored Division left the square and, heading east on Chang'an Avenue, came upon a lone protester standing in the middle of the avenue. The brief standoff between the man and the tanks was captured by Western media atop the Beijing Hotel.

Dos soldados murieron quemados vivos dentro del vehículo blindado y un tercero se vio obligado a salir debido al intenso calor y fue golpeado hasta la muerte a la vista de otros soldados, lo cual provocó un tiroteo como represalia.
translation: Two soldiers died burned alive inside the armored vehicle and a third was forced to exit due to the intense heat and was beaten to death in view of other soldiers, which provoked a shooting in retaliation.

quote: Sức nóng dữ dội đã đẩy ba binh sĩ ở trong phải chạy ra, và bị những người biểu tình vây chặt. Các xe APC đã được báo cáo đã đè bẹp hàng loạt lều dựng tạm và nhiều người trong đám đông muốn đánh lại những người lính. Nhưng các học sinh đã tạo ra một tường dây bảo vệ và hộ tống ba binh sĩ đến trạm y tế gần Bảo tàng Lịch sử ở phía đông của Quảng trường.
section: Người biểu tình tấn công các binh sĩ
translation: The intense heat forced the three soldiers inside to run out, and they were surrounded by protesters. The APCs were reported to have crushed a series of makeshift tents and many in the crowd wanted to beat the soldiers. But the students created a protective cordon and escorted the three soldiers to the medical station near the Museum of History on the east side of the Square.

quote: 由于車輛遇焚而緊急逃出的3名軍人則被示威群眾毆打，但學生則組織警戒線并護送3人到位於廣場東側中國國家博物館的急救站醫治。
translation: The 3 soldiers who urgently escaped because the vehicle was burning were beaten by the demonstrating crowd, but students organized a cordon and escorted the 3 men to the first-aid station at the National Museum of China on the east side of the square for treatment.

quote: Wu Renhua claims that after the three occupants were forced out of the vehicle by the heat, students escorted the three men to a medic station. However, according to an eyewitness account of a Chinese-American reporter, the soldiers were attacked by the crowd. Two soldiers were burned alive inside the APC, and a third was dragged out of the vehicle and beaten to death in full view of other soldiers.
Hàng năm, có một cuộc tuần hành lớn tại Hồng Kông, nơi mọi người tưởng niệm các nạn nhân và yêu cầu Cộng hòa Nhân dân Trung Hoa thay đổi quan điểm chính thức của mình.
section: Chủ đề cấm tại Lục địa Trung Quốc
translation: Every year, a large march takes place in Hong Kong, where people commemorate the victims and demand that the PRC change its official position.

quote: Ha habido grandes vigilias con velas a las que asisten decenas de miles en Hong Kong cada año desde 1989, incluso después de la transferencia del poder a China en 1997.
translation: Large candlelight vigils attended by tens of thousands have been held in Hong Kong every year since 1989, even after the transfer of power to China in 1997.

quote: There have been large candlelight vigils attended by tens of thousands in Hong Kong every year since 1989, even after the transfer of power to China in 1997.
なお、香港では、2020年以降、それまで毎年6月4日に行われていた追悼集会が当局の締付けにより開催されず、また、同年9月の新学期以降の高校の必修教科書から、天安門事件など中国共産党にとって都合の悪い項目が削除されることになった。
section: イギリス領香港の反応
translation: In Hong Kong, from 2020 onward, the annual 4 June memorial gatherings were not held because of official restrictions; items inconvenient for the CCP, including Tiananmen, were also to be removed from compulsory secondary-school textbooks from the September school term.

quote: 香港在1997年主權轉移給中國後，相關的紀念活動仍在持續進行，直至2020年《港區國安法》生效。
translation: The commemorations continued after Hong Kong's transfer of sovereignty to China in 1997, until the Hong Kong National Security Law took effect in 2020.

quote: 2020 wurde sie von den Behörden erstmals verboten, dennoch fanden sich Zehntausende zu Mahnwachen ein.
translation: In 2020, the authorities banned it for the first time, although tens of thousands nevertheless gathered for vigils.

quote: Depuis 2020, cette manifestation est interdite.
translation: Since 2020, this demonstration has been banned.

quote: 同时，“动乱”和“暴乱”的定性也一直维持，出现在介绍“1989年春夏之交的政治风波”的具体文字中。
translation: At the same time, the characterizations 'turmoil' and 'riot' have continuously been retained in texts describing the 'political turmoil between spring and summer 1989'.

quote: As the events unfolded, it was labelled a "counter revolutionary rebellion", which was later changed to simply "riot", followed by "political turmoil" and "1989 storm".
其中一男子阻擋坦克行進的圖像變成该事件重要的標誌，该男子被称为“坦克人”，且長期在西方社會成為公民反抗專制政權的象徵。
translation: The image of a man blocking tanks became an important emblem of the events; called 'Tank Man', he has long symbolized civilian resistance to authoritarian rule in Western societies.

quote: 男性は身元不明だがデモ隊ではなく中国政府側の人間だと思われる。中国政府の自作自演で「戦車は民衆を轢かないよ」というパフォーマンスとして行われたものである。
translation: The man's identity is unknown, but he is thought to have belonged to the Chinese government side rather than the demonstrators. It was a performance staged by the Chinese government to convey that tanks do not run over people.

quote: On June 5, after military forces cleared the Square, an unidentified individual, later referred to as "Tank Man" briefly stood in front of a column of tanks, temporarily blocking their movement.

Several people who were situated around the square that night, including former Beijing bureau chief of The Washington Post Jay Mathews and CBS correspondent Richard Roth reported that while they had heard sporadic gunfire, they could not find enough evidence to suggest that a massacre took place on the square.
section: Deaths around and in Tiananmen Square itself

quote: なお、これは前述のごとく、天安門広場での死者は出なかったが、周辺では多数の死者が出たという認識が正しいと思われる。
translation: As mentioned above, the understanding that nobody died in Tiananmen Square but many died nearby appears to be correct.

quote: しかし、大量の虐殺が広場でなかったとはいえ広場での数名の死者や多くの重軽傷者、そして広場以外で少なくとも300人以上が殺害されたと言う欧米側の記録がある。
translation: However, although there was no large-scale massacre in the square, Western records report several deaths and many serious and minor injuries there, and at least 300 people killed outside it.

quote: Ни один человек не был убит непосредственно на Тяньаньмэнь, но известно об одиннадцати студентах, которые были убиты уже за пределами площади, их давили танками.
translation: Nobody was killed directly on Tiananmen, but eleven students are known to have been killed outside the square, where tanks crushed them.

quote: Auf dem Platz selbst kamen keine Menschen ums Leben; er wurde nach Verhandlungen zwischen dem Militär und den Studenten vor der Drohkulisse aufgefahrener Panzer geräumt.
translation: Nobody died on the square itself; it was cleared following negotiations between the military and students under the threat of deployed tanks.

quote: Утром 3 июня невооружённые части НОАК пытались войти на площадь, но были отброшены, а поздно вечером того же дня в Пекин вошли армейские подразделения с танками, которые встретили вооружённое сопротивление, доходящее до открытых вооружённых столкновений, особенно ожесточённое на южном и западном подступах к Тяньаньмэнь.
translation: On the morning of 3 June, unarmed PLA units tried to enter the square but were driven back; late that evening, army units with tanks entered Beijing and encountered armed resistance escalating into open clashes, especially on the southern and western approaches to Tiananmen.

quote: Die zunehmende Gewalt gegen die Zivilbevölkerung führte zu einer allgemeinen Eskalation, in der auch mehrere Soldaten entweder mit bloßen Händen getötet wurden oder durch Molotowcocktails und andere improvisierte Waffen ums Leben kamen.
translation: Increasing violence against civilians led to a general escalation in which several soldiers were also killed with bare hands, Molotov cocktails or other improvised weapons.

quote: Những người lính trút đạn vào các tòa nhà chung cư, và một số người bên trong hoặc trên ban công của tòa nhà đã bị bắn.
translation: Soldiers poured bullets into apartment buildings, and some people inside or on their balconies were shot.

quote: Trái với ấn tượng do truyền thông phuơng Tây tạo ra, thực tế quân Trung Quốc chủ yếu dùng dùi cui và gậy gộc chứ không nổ súng.
translation: Contrary to the impression created by Western media, Chinese troops in fact mainly used batons and clubs rather than opening fire.

quote: Este ejército se encontró con un bloqueo establecido por manifestantes en Gongzhufen, en el distrito de Haidian, y los enfrentamientos estallaron cuando los manifestantes arrojaron piedras, cócteles molotov y otros objetos contra el ejército, que respondió disparando balas de goma y gas lacrimógeno y atacando con porras y bastones eléctricos.
translation: This army encountered a demonstrator blockade at Gongzhufen in Haidian district; clashes broke out when protesters threw stones, Molotov cocktails and other objects, and the army responded with rubber bullets, tear gas, batons and electric truncheons.

quote: En 1989, ni l'armée chinoise ni la police de Pékin n'avaient d'équipements anti-émeute, balles en caoutchouc et gaz lacrymogènes pourtant utilisés depuis longtemps dans les pays occidentaux.
section: Impacts sur les tendances de politique intérieure
translation: In 1989, neither the Chinese army nor Beijing police had riot-control equipment, rubber bullets or tear gas, although these had long been used in Western countries.

quote: Los estudiantes comenzaron la huelga de hambre el 13 de mayo, dos días antes de la visita de estado muy publicitada del líder soviético Mijaíl Gorbachov.
translation: Students began the hunger strike on 13 May, two days before Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev's highly publicized state visit.

quote: La grève commence le 13 mai et comptera plus de mille participants.
translation: The strike begins on 13 May and will have more than a thousand participants.

quote: Le 12 mai, les étudiants entament une grève de la faim illimitée sur la place Tian'anmen, grève qui finira par concerner plus de 1 000 personnes.
section: Cortèges de protestation et grève de la faim
translation: On 12 May, students begin an indefinite hunger strike in Tiananmen Square, eventually involving more than 1,000 people.

quote: Vào sáng sớm ngày 19 tháng 5, Triệu Tử Dương đã đi cùng với Ôn Gia Bảo.
translation: In the early morning of 19 May, Zhao Ziyang went with Wen Jiabao.

quote: In the early morning of 19 May, Zhao Ziyang went to Tiananmen in what became his political swan song.
Chính phủ Trung Quốc đã tuyên bố thiết quân luật vào ngày 20 tháng 5, và huy động khoảng 250.000 quân đến thủ đô Bắc Kinh.
translation: The Chinese government declared martial law on 20 May and mobilized approximately 250,000 troops to Beijing.

quote: Chính phủ Trung Quốc ban đầu chỉ đàm phán để người biểu tình tự giải tán, nhưng sau khi một số người biểu tình quá khích tấn công, giết hại một số binh lính và đốt các đoàn xe, ngày 4 tháng 6, chính phủ tuyên bố thiết quân luật và cử quân đội dẹp bỏ những người biểu tình đang đóng tại Quảng trường Thiên An Môn.
translation: The Chinese government initially only negotiated for protesters to disperse voluntarily, but after some extremist protesters attacked and killed soldiers and burned vehicle columns, on 4 June the government declared martial law and sent troops to remove protesters occupying Tiananmen Square.
